sources.title: BLIP-2 (Li et al.)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

sources.title: Visual Instruction Tuning / LLaVA (Liu et al.)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Language-only GPT-4 instruction-data generation: image unseen by teacher; image encoded as symbolic sequences of multi-perspective captions plus bounding boxes [x1,y1,x2,y2]; COCO-sourced; 158K unique samples (58K conversation + 23K detailed description + 77K complex reasoning); seed examples are the only human annotations.

Architecture/interface: CLIP ViT-L/14 visual encoder connected to Vicuna LLM through a single trainable projection matrix W (system described as end-to-end trained large multimodal model at the whole-system level).
Stage 1 feature-alignment pre-training: visual encoder FROZEN and LLM FROZEN; ONLY the projection matrix W trainable (theta=W); 595K CC3M-derived pairs; single-turn naive-expansion format.

Stage 2 instruction tuning: visual encoder REMAINS FROZEN (always); projection layer AND LLM updated (theta={W,phi}); 158K instruction-following (multi-turn conversation + detailed + complex, uniformly sampled) or ScienceQA single-turn variant. The vision encoder is nowhere updated end-to-end; end-to-end phrasing is system-level (vs coordination systems), not component-level.
claims.context: Paper §4.2 Stage 2 + Eq.(3) + §5/App.C hyperparams; system-vs-component distinction per §1/§2/§4.1/App.B Fig.6.

claims.text: Evaluation conditions: LLaVA-Bench (COCO) 85.1% All relative to text-only GPT-4 reference under the triplet/judge protocol (30 images x 3 types); In-the-Wild 67.3 vs BLIP-2 38.1; ScienceQA 90.92% alone and 92.53% ensemble with GPT-4-as-judge (reasoning-first, visual features before last layer, 12 epochs); LLaVA-Bench limits paper-acknowledged (knowledge/multilingual/retrieval/high-resolution/bag-of-patches failures incl. yogurt case).

X01 exhibit: machine-generated instruction-following data as a supervision contract — the data-composition claim Evidence must carry (caption+box proxy symbols; 158K composition; 595K alignment subset).
claims.context: Edition synthesis over claims 1/3/4; X01 supervision-timeline role.

limitations.text: Synthetic instruction-data dependence; failure cases paper-acknowledged via LLaVA-Bench; knowledge/multilingual/internet-retrieval/high-resolution perception bounds per paper Limitations.

targets.finding: Complete LLaVA paper body consumed via arXiv HTML (78KB text): GPT-4 data generation, tuning design, benchmark results, LLaVA-Bench failure cases verified.

Primary full-body re-verified 2026-10-04 against bound locator (read-only web fetch of arXiv HTML); pinpoints recorded per claim context. Old end-to-end vision-encoder+LLM tuning claim removed as factually wrong.

sources.title: MiniGPT-4 (Zhu et al.)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Single projection layer aligning frozen visual encoder with frozen Vicuna unlocks GPT-4-like compositional abilities (detailed description, website-from-sketch, stories/poems, cooking instruction); two-stage curation (short captions then detailed-description finetuning) fixes repetition/fragmentation; code+models+data open.

Visual stack provenance: BLIP-2-derived ViT-G/14 (EVA-CLIP) plus pretrained Q-Former, BOTH frozen throughout all MiniGPT-4 training; querying happens inside the reused frozen Q-Former; MiniGPT-4's own trainable path is only the linear map of Q-Former output into Vicuna space (no own query selection, no dense cross-attention).
claims.context: Paper Abstract/§1/§3/§3.1/Fig.1 (freezes all other vision and language components).

claims.text: Two-stage data: ~5M Conceptual-Captions/SBU/LAION pairs (20k steps x batch 256) for alignment pre-training; ~3.5K/5K ChatGPT-refined detailed descriptions (400 steps x batch 12) for curation finetuning.

Q-Former removal is an ablation variant (MiniGPT-4 w/o Q-Former maps ViT output directly; AOK-VQA/GQA near-parity, paper concludes non-critical for advanced skills); 3-linear-layer and finetune-Q-Former variants are worse. Vicuna-vs-Flan-T5 control shows weaker LLM benefits less.

limitations.text: Short treatment per bridge-function role; alignment-fragility notes need eval-side sources.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

targets.finding: Full body consumed: single-layer alignment, two-stage curation, compositional exhibits verified.
